/phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu skye dgu'i re skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

tei:div.tei:p: /phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid yig yid bzhin gyi nor bu skye dgu'i re skong zhes bya ba bzhugs so/

na mo gu ru rat+na bh+yaḥ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ zab mo lnga ldan gyi rim pa sgom par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro rnams spyi ltar du nyams su len par byed/ thun mong ma yin pa byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa la/ lnga ldan gyi gzhung las/ byams dang snying rje'i rta pho la// gzhan phan gyi dkyus thog ma bcad na// khrom lha mi'i 'or che mi 'byung bas// sems sngon 'gro 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ dang por byams pa bsgom pa 'di ltar bya ste/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan na ci ma rung*/ bde ba dang ldan par bya/ bde ba dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsgoms la/ byams lhang gis lhan ne song nas 'bral snying mi 'dod pa zhig 'byung ste/ byams pa skyes pa'o// de bzhin du snying rje'i dmigs pa ni/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra /gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i log 'dren bdud dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor gyis gtso byas pa'i nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ci ma rung*/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar bya/ sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig snyam du bsgoms pas/ rang nyid sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa bzhin du/ sems can thams cad sdug bsngal dang bral na ang snyam du byung ba snying rje skyes pa'o// de ltar byams snying rje skyes kyang byang chub kyi sems ma skyes na mthar thug gi 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che'i zhal nas/ re zhig sngon 'gro bde ba ste// nges par 'dod pa thar pa yin// zhes pas/

nges par legs pa'i yon tan thob par byed pa la/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom dgos te/ smon 'jug don dam gsum las/ smon pa'i dmigs pa sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi/ ma grol ba dgrol bar bya/ nyan rang gi theg pa las ngal ma sos pa dbugs dbyung bar bya/ yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams/ yongs su myang 'das kyi sa la 'god par bya snyam du bsgom pa'o// 'jug pa byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i dmigs pa ni/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i don du/ dus de ring nas bzung ste sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ zab mo lnga ldan gyi rim pa shes par bya'o snyam pa'o// don dam byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la 'jog pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pa'i phan yon ni/ spyod 'jug las/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing lta bu ste// 'bras bu skyes nas zad par 'gyur bas na// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par ni// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes so// des sngon 'gro song nas/ dngos gzhi bsgom pa la/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs gnyis las/ dang por bskyed rim sgom dgos te/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ rang lus lha sku'i rgyal po la// gzhi 'gyur med kyi brtan sa ma zin na// ma mkha' 'gro'i 'khor tshogs mi 'du bas// lus yi dam gyi lha la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ bskyed rim mngon byang lngas bskyed par byed dgos te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bha wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum ldan gyi dbus su nyi ma zla ba/ de'i steng du rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes par gyur pa ni/ sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ral pa'i thor gtsug la yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/

ral pa'i logs g.yas su sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon du zla ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyang zhing*/ phyag rgya drug dang rus pa'i rgyan cha drug gis spras pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i bdag nyid du gnas pa'i pang du/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis mas 'khyud cing*/ yum gyi rtsa zhal dmar po khro zhal/ steng zhal phag gi gdong pa can/ thod pa skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rdo rje dang gri gug 'dzin pas snyoms par 'jug pa'i bdag nyid du bsgom/ yab yum gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ dbang bskur lus gang dri ma dag chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par bsgoms te/ ngag tu bzlas pa bya ba ni/ gtso bo'i nye snying*/ oṃ hrīḥha ha huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ yum gyi nye snying*/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud 'od du zhu/ yum la thim/ yum yab la thim/ yab thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ zhabs kyu khog pa mgo bo zla tshes/ thig le/ nā da'i bar du thim nas mi dmigs pa'i ngang du 'jog de'i ngang du rdzogs rim bsgom pa ni/ rdzogs rim skye bar byed pa la bla ma'i mos gus las skye dgos te/ kyai rdo rje las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus mtha' bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes pas/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ bla ma sku bzhi'i gangs ri la// mos gus kyi nyi ma ma shar na// byin rlabs kyi chu rgyun mi 'byung bas// sems mos gus 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ bla ma sku bzhir bsgrub dgos te/ bla ma kun 'dus su bsgoms pas khyab pa yin te/ rang nyid yi dam lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i spyi bor seng ge brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri steng du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang nyid kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa de nyid/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po bai ḍūr+ya'i rtse mor nyi ma'i 'od kyis reg pa ltar sngo zhing*/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu thugs khar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gi bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs/ bla ma dang gnyis su med par thim pas/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid du bsgoms te/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa maṇ+ḍal dang bcas pa phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pas mchod de/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku yi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i gsung la gsol ba 'debs so// dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bor gyur pa bla ma rin po che'i thugs la gsol ba 'debs so// zhes gsol ba btab nas/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge gsum las 'od zer dkar po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngon po byung bas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la phog sdig sgrib dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/

gsang ba dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob par bsam ste/ ye shes thig le'i rgyud las/ bla ma'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du// dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par zhus// rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /sa lam gyi rim pa ma lus rdzogs// zhes pa'i don yin/ mthar bla ma de nyid 'od du zhu nas rang nyid la thim/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med pa'i ngang la bzhag /de nyid kyi ngang nas rdzogs rim sgom pa ni/ lnga ldan gzhung las/ sems nyid kyi nam mkha' yangs pa la// rnam rtog gi sprin tshogs ma dengs na// mkhyen gnyis kyi gza' skar mi bkra bas// sems mi rtog 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bskyed par byed pa la/ rten 'brel lus la bsgrigs pas rtogs pa sems la 'char bas/ rkang pa rdo rje dkyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag phyag rgya/ lus bsrang*/ mig sna rtser zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkha' la gtad la rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan gyis gnas te/ dmigs pa rang sems ma bcos par bzhag de ltar bsgoms pas rnam rtog dag cing*/ mi rtog pa rgyal ba chos sku thob pa ste/ rje til+li pa'i zhal nas/ lus kyi bya ba yongs thongs rnal mar sdod// ngag gi smra brjod ma mang grag stong brag cha 'dra// yid la ci yang mi bsam zla lo'i chos la ltos// ma bcos gnyug ma chos sku'i ngang la zhog /bcings pa glod na grol bar the tshom med// sems kyi rang bzhin gdod nas nam mkha' 'dra// chos rnams thams cad de ru ma 'dus med// ces pa'o// mnyam gzhag de las langs nas bsngo ba byed dgos te/ lnga ldan gyi gzhung las/ tshogs gnyis yid bzhin gyi nor bu la// smon lam gyis byi dor ma byas na// dgos 'dod kyi 'bras bu mi 'byung bas// rjes bsngo ba 'di la nan tan mdzod// ces pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ge dang*/ pad+ma nyi zla'i steng du bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bsngo ba'i dpang por bzhugs par bsgoms la/

bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /ces pas bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ gshis la gnas pa'i dge rtsa rnams so// bsngo ba de sems can thams cad la thob bya de 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang du bsngo ba yin te/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan bsngo ba'i le'u las/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dang*// bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig /ces pa'i don no// de ltar rgyu'i rtsa ba byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ gsang sngags kyi snying po yi dam gyi lha bsgom pa dang*/ yon tan gyi snying po bla ma bsgom pa dang*/ don gyi snying po phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i snying po bsngo ba byed pa ste/ dam pa'i chos lnga ldan gyi khrid kyi rim pa 'di nyid mnyam med skyu ra'i gdung rigs las byung zhing lugs gnyis kyi mnga' dbang la mtha' gru rgyas pa/ mtshan dngos byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs ldan rin chen dpal 'byor bsam grub rgya mtshos bskul ba las rdo rje 'dzin pa ā nan+da rat+na chos kyi rgyal pos sbyar ba'o/// /
